[[File:Duros_officer2.jpg|thumb|The Duros were among the earliest spacefating species.]]
'''Spacefaring''' [[Species/Legends|species]] were those capable of traveling in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] through the use of [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> According to the standard classification of [[Technology level|technological development]], it was a characteristic of civilizations having reached at least the information level.<ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref> Most spacefaring civilizations also developed fusion technology. Some of the earliest spacefaring species included the [[Anzat/Legends|Anzati]], the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronians]], the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]], the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotals]], the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]], and the [[Zabrak]]. By contrast, the [[Kaleesh]] only became spacefaring late in history.<ref name="NEGAS" />
